Messages.Author: Algustas
Messages.Body:
Hi Sarah,

On Thu, 1 Aug 1996, Sarah Warlund wrote:

>
> As the Castle does not specify a time when it can be taped, I use it in a
> manner similar to the barrens, and tap at any time to transfer
> blood/equipement/etc. The only restriction is that I cannot transfer an
> equipement if I've just used it in combat.
>
I would check with the rulemongers on this one, I believe the
card has errata stating it may not be used in combat (at all). I believe
you are perfectly legal using it any other time though.

Messages.Author: Sarah Warlund
Messages.Body:
chick...@aol.com (ChickLewis) wrote:

> In my opinion, tapping the castle is like an action, and it must be
> completed before or after you play your master card, not during or
> throughout.
>

As the Castle does not specify a time when it can be taped, I use it in a

manner similar to the barrens, and tap at any time to transfer
blood/equipement/etc. The only restriction is that I cannot transfer an
equipement if I've just used it in combat.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
warl...@coral.concordia.ca (Sarah Warlund) writes:

> chick...@aol.com (ChickLewis) wrote:

>> In my opinion, tapping the castle is like an action, and it must be
>> completed before or after you play your master card, not during or
>> throughout.
>>

>As the Castle does not specify a time when it can be taped, I use it in a
>manner similar to the barrens, and tap at any time to transfer
>blood/equipement/etc. The only restriction is that I cannot transfer an
>equipement if I've just used it in combat.

Actually, the restriction (errata) is: Heidelburg cannot be used to
transfer anything to or from a minion in combat.
